title: Owl holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='owlBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c08457'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9a6236'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='30' fill='url(#owlBody)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='20' fill='#f4d9a8'/>
  <!-- belly feather chevrons -->
  <path d='M42 60 L50 66 L58 60' stroke='#d8ad72' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 70 L50 76 L57 70' stroke='#d8ad72' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='64' rx='9' ry='20' fill='#8a5330'/>
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='64' rx='9' ry='20' fill='#8a5330'/>
  <!-- wing tips curled forward to hold heart -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='80' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a86a3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='80' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a86a3d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='25' ry='22' fill='url(#owlBody)'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M32 16 L26 6 L40 12 Z' fill='#8a5330'/>
  <path d='M68 16 L74 6 L60 12 Z' fill='#8a5330'/>
  <!-- face disc -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='34' r='13' fill='#f4d9a8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='34' r='13' fill='#f4d9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='34' r='7' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='34' r='7' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='34' r='3.2' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 40 L45 47 L55 47 Z' fill='#ff9f3f'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 90 L36 96 M40 90 L40 97 M40 90 L44 96' stroke='#ff9f3f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 90 L56 96 M60 90 L60 97 M60 90 L64 96' stroke='#ff9f3f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart held between wing tips -->
  <path d='M50 92 C42 84 34 80 34 74 C34 69 39 67 43 69 C46 71 48 74 50 77 C52 74 54 71 57 69 C61 67 66 69 66 74 C66 80 58 84 50 92 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M50 88 C44 82 39 79 39 75' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
